name: Sound spike
author: Edgemodders
description: The test of Sound Tools' SP1 (docs/sound.md): traces the events the game posts to Wwise and the sounds it loads (audio.trace), names the events through REDbridge's list, plays an event by name (audio.event) and a sound by id (audio.playGame). Writes what it finds to the Mod log. Asks for the bridge permission, for the names.
